headline: Battered by war, Iran’s rulers wary of more economic pain and unrest if US tightens pressure
summary: Iran's leaders fear that a threat of more US economic punishment could deepen hardship and reignite unrest, according to Reuters. US President Trump vowed to hit Iran hard economically.
why: Sanctions and economic pressure on Iran affect global oil supply, regional stability and investor risk appetite in the Middle East.
